text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Violent crime rates in the United States 1979 to 2024
Estimated rates per 100,000 people. Violent crime includes four offenses: murder and non-negligent
manslaughter, rape, robbery, and aggravated assault. Data for rape is not shown due to the lack of comparable

tspan.tspan: The FBI takes reported crime data and adjusts it for gaps and underreporting to provide consistent long-term estimates over time. That

text.tspan: means it may be different to reported crime figures.
